# NEXUS: AI-Powered Criminal Network Analysis Dashboard Frontend

Build a law-enforcement intelligence dashboard frontend named **NEXUS**, inspired by professional tactical intelligence platforms (e.g. Palantir Gotham, Analyst's Notebook, Maltego). The interface will feature high-density data displays, intelligence classification markings, dark/light tactical styling, interactive network analysis graph visualization, multi-entity dossiers, evidence ingestion vaults, and case timelines.

## User Review Required

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The project will be initialized in `C:\Users\Nityam Jaiswal\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\nexus`. Once created, you can open this directory as your active workspace in your editor.

> [!NOTE]
> All mock data is pre-populated with realistic, interconnected criminal investigation scenarios (e.g. Operation "Ghost Syndicate", international money laundering, shell companies, burner phone intercepts, and high-value targets) so every page feels live and functional out of the box.

## Proposed Architecture & Design

### Tactical Visual Design System
- **Theme**: Dark Tactical Intelligence (default) + Clean Analytical Light Mode, switchable via Top Nav and Settings.
- **Palette**: Deep slate/zinc backdrop (`#090d16` / `#0f172a`), emerald/cyan telemetry indicators, amber warning highlights, crimson critical alerts, and subtle border grids.
- **Typography & Details**: High-contrast typography with monospace serial IDs, timestamps, clearance badges (`TOP SECRET // SI // NOFORN`), threat score meters, and status pills.
- **Motion**: Subtle, purposeful state transitions; zero distracting or excessive animations.

---

## Proposed Changes

### Project Initialization & Core Configuration
- Scaffold Vite + React + TypeScript in `C:\Users\Nityam Jaiswal\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\nexus`.
- Install dependencies: `react-router-dom`, `lucide-react`, `clsx`, `tailwind-merge`, `canvas-confetti` (for verification/actions if needed), and Tailwind CSS toolchain.
- Configure Tailwind CSS with custom intelligence color tokens, glowing status indicators, and tactical typography.

### Type Definitions & Mock Intelligence Datasets

#### [NEW] [src/types/index.ts](file:///C:/Users/Nityam%20Jaiswal/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/nexus/src/types/index.ts)
- `Entity`: Suspects, shell corporations, bank accounts, burner phones, safehouses, vehicles, with risk scores, aliases, status, and coordinates.
- `Case`: Case ID, title, lead agent, priority (Critical, High, Medium), status, warrants count, seized assets, entities linked.
- `Evidence`: ID, type (CDR, Financial, Wiretap, Photo, Forensics, PDF), chain of custody hash (SHA-256), officer badge, AI extraction findings.
- `TimelineEvent`: Date, entity ID, event category (Wire, Border, Intercept, Sighting, Raid), confidence score, summary, location.
- `NetworkGraphData`: Nodes (type, risk level, cluster ID, coordinates/forces) and Edges (transaction, associate, comms, weight, encrypted).
- `ThreatAlert`: Alert level, source, timestamp, AI anomaly summary, actionable triggers.

#### [NEW] [src/data/mockData.ts](file:///C:/Users/Nityam%20Jaiswal/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/nexus/src/data/mockData.ts)
- Interconnected criminal network dataset revolving around "Operation Phantom Web" and "The Ramos Syndicate" with 18+ nodes, 28+ edges, 6 cases, 20+ evidence records, and 15 timeline events.

---

### UI Component Library (shadcn/ui-inspired)
Reusable, accessible atomic components styled for tactical intelligence.

#### [NEW] [src/components/network/NetworkGraphContainer.tsx](file:///C:/Users/Nityam%20Jaiswal/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/nexus/src/components/network/NetworkGraphContainer.tsx)
- Interactive canvas/SVG network topology renderer featuring:
  - Multi-node types (Suspects, Shell Corps, Vehicles, Accounts, Safehouses)

#### [NEW] [src/components/common/AlertCard.tsx](file:///C:/Users/Nityam%20Jaiswal/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/nexus/src/components/common/AlertCard.tsx)
- High-priority operational alert card with severity badge (CRITICAL, HIGH, ELEVATED), source feed, AI rationale, and triage buttons (Acknowledge, Escalate, Open Case).

---

### Application Pages (8 Core Routes)

1. #### [NEW] [src/pages/LoginPage.tsx](file:///C:/Users/Nityam%20Jaiswal/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/nexus/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx)
   - Secure law-enforcement portal with badge authentication, biometric verification simulation, agency division selector (e.g. Transnational Crime / Anti-Money Laundering), clearance statement, and one-click demo login buttons.

2. #### [NEW] [src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx](file:///C:/Users/Nityam%20Jaiswal/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/nexus/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx)
   - Command Center featuring high-level threat metrics, priority AI alert feed, active wiretaps/surveillance stream, active cases table, and an interactive mini threat topology radar.

3. #### [NEW] [src/pages/CasesPage.tsx](file:///C:/Users/Nityam%20Jaiswal/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/nexus/src/pages/CasesPage.tsx)
   - Case dossier management with priority filtering, active warrants count, asset seizure tally, case creation modal, and drill-down to linked entities and evidence binders.

4. #### [NEW] [src/pages/UploadEvidencePage.tsx](file:///C:/Users/Nityam%20Jaiswal/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/nexus/src/pages/UploadEvidencePage.tsx)
   - Ingestion vault supporting CDR logs, financial records, audio transcripts, surveillance imagery. Includes automated SHA-256 hash generator, chain-of-custody logging form, and real-time mock AI entity extraction pipeline.

5. #### [NEW] [src/pages/NetworkAnalysisPage.tsx](file:///C:/Users/Nityam%20Jaiswal/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/nexus/src/pages/NetworkAnalysisPage.tsx)
   - Full-screen intelligence graph investigation workbench with interactive node inspection, edge filtering, cluster analysis, shortest-path calculation, threat level filters, and export options.

6. #### [NEW] [src/pages/EntityProfilePage.tsx](file:///C:/Users/Nityam%20Jaiswal/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/nexus/src/pages/EntityProfilePage.tsx)
   - Deep-dive intelligence dossier for high-value targets (HVTs) and shell corporations with tabbed views: Overview, Known Associates, Financial Footprint, Intercepts, Linked Evidence, and AI Flight Risk / Threat Assessment.

7. #### [NEW] [src/pages/TimelinePage.tsx](file:///C:/Users/Nityam%20Jaiswal/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/nexus/src/pages/TimelinePage.tsx)
   - Chronological investigation timeline with filterable event streams (Wire transfers, cell tower pings, border crossings, physical sightings), multi-entity correlation filters, and detail inspection modals.

export type EntityType = 
  | 'suspect' 
  | 'organization' 
  | 'shell_company' 
  | 'vehicle' 
  | 'burner_phone' 
  | 'bank_account' 
  | 'safehouse'

export type RiskLevel = 'CRITICAL' | 'HIGH' | 'ELEVATED' | 'LOW'

export interface Entity {
  id: string
  name: string
  type: EntityType
  riskScore: number // 0-100
  riskLevel: RiskLevel
  status: 'Active Warrant' | 'Under Surveillance' | 'Detained' | 'Fugitive' | 'Flagged Entity' | 'Monitored'
  aliases: string[]
  primaryAffiliation: string
  role: string
  nationality?: string
  photo?: string
  lastKnownLocation: {
    name: string
    lat: number
    lng: number
    timestamp: string
  }
  tags: string[]
  details: {
    dob?: string
    pob?: string
    wantedFor?: string[]
    biometrics?: string
    knownAssociatesCount: number
    totalFinancialFlow: string
    wiretapsCount: number
  }
}

export type CaseStatus = 
  | 'Active Investigation' 
  | 'Grand Jury' 
  | 'Surveillance Phase' 
  | 'Interdiction Imminent' 
  | 'Closed'

export type PriorityLevel = 'CRITICAL' | 'HIGH' | 'MEDIUM'

export interface Case {
  id: string
  caseNumber: string
  title: string
  description: string
  codeName: string
  status: CaseStatus
  priority: PriorityLevel
  leadInvestigator: string
  agency: string
  jurisdiction: string
  openedDate: string
  lastUpdated: string
  warrantsIssued: number
  assetsSeized: string
  entitiesCount: number
  evidenceCount: number
  riskIndex: number
}

export type EvidenceType = 
  | 'cdr' 
  | 'financial' 
  | 'wiretap' 
  | 'surveillance' 
  | 'forensics' 
  | 'document'

export type ClassificationLevel = 
  | 'TOP SECRET // SI' 
  | 'SECRET // NOFORN' 
  | 'CONFIDENTIAL' 
  | 'LAW ENFORCEMENT SENSITIVE'

export interface Evidence {
  id: string
  evidenceNumber: string
  caseId: string
  caseName: string
  title: string
  type: EvidenceType
  classification: ClassificationLevel
  dateCollected: string
  collectedBy: string
  badgeNumber: string
  location: string
  hashSHA256: string
  aiSummary: string
  aiExtractionTags: string[]
  linkedEntityIds: string[]
  fileDetails: {
    filename: string
    size: string
    duration?: string
    format: string
  }
}

export type EventCategory = 
  | 'wiretap' 
  | 'financial' 
  | 'sighting' 
  | 'border' 
  | 'warrant' 
  | 'comm'

export interface TimelineEvent {
  id: string
  timestamp: string
  title: string
  description: string
  category: EventCategory
  entityIds: string[]
  entityNames: string[]
  caseId: string
  severity: 'critical' | 'high' | 'info' | 'warning'
  location: string
  confidenceScore: number
  evidenceRef?: string
}

export interface GraphNode {
  id: string
  label: string
  type: EntityType
  riskScore: number
  degree: number
  betweenness: number
  cluster: string
  status: string
  isHVT?: boolean
  x?: number
  y?: number
  vx?: number
  vy?: number
}

export type EdgeRelationship = 
  | 'wire_transfer' 
  | 'known_associate' 
  | 'encrypted_call' 
  | 'director' 
  | 'courier' 
  | 'vehicle_registered'
  | 'safehouse_access'

export interface GraphEdge {
  id: string
  source: string
  target: string
  relationship: EdgeRelationship
  label: string
  amount?: string
  frequency?: number
  isSuspicious: boolean
  weight: number
}

export interface NetworkGraphData {
  nodes: GraphNode[]
  edges: GraphEdge[]
}

export type AlertSeverity = 'CRITICAL' | 'HIGH' | 'ELEVATED' | 'ROUTINE'

  id: string

  relatedEntityName?: string

  confidence: number

  change: string
  trend: 'up' | 'down' | 'neutral'

import React from 'react'
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { ThemeProvider } from './context/ThemeContext'
import { AppLayout } from './components/layout/AppLayout'
import { LoginPage } from './pages/LoginPage'
import { DashboardPage } from './pages/DashboardPage'
import { CasesPage } from './pages/CasesPage'
import { UploadEvidencePage } from './pages/UploadEvidencePage'
import { NetworkAnalysisPage } from './pages/NetworkAnalysisPage'
import { EntityProfilePage } from './pages/EntityProfilePage'
import { TimelinePage } from './pages/TimelinePage'
import { SettingsPage } from './pages/SettingsPage'

export function App() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider>
      <BrowserRouter>
        <Routes>
          {/* Unauthenticated Login Portal */}
          <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />

          {/* Authenticated Dashboard Shell Layout */}
          <Route path="/" element={<AppLayout />}>
            <Route index element={<DashboardPage />} />
            <Route path="cases" element={<CasesPage />} />
            <Route path="upload" element={<UploadEvidencePage />} />
            <Route path="network" element={<NetworkAnalysisPage />} />
            <Route path="entity/:id" element={<EntityProfilePage />} />
            <Route path="entity" element={<EntityProfilePage />} />
            <Route path="timeline" element={<TimelinePage />} />
            <Route path="settings" element={<SettingsPage />} />
          </Route>

          {/* Fallback */}
          <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
        </Routes>
      </BrowserRouter>
    </ThemeProvider>
  )
}

export default App

args.CodeContent:
# NEXUS // Criminal Network Analysis Intelligence Dashboard

NEXUS is an AI-powered criminal network analysis frontend designed for law enforcement and intelligence task forces. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, React Router, and tactical UI primitives inspired by Palantir Gotham, Analyst's Notebook, and Maltego.

---

## Workspace Location
The complete frontend project has been created and verified at:
`C:\Users\Nityam Jaiswal\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\nexus`

---

## Key Features & Completed Pages

### 1. Login (`/login`)
- **Law-Enforcement Gate**: Title 18 U.S.C. § 1030 warning header with real-time AES-256 link status.
- **Officer Credentials**: Badge ID (`FED-8491`), encrypted hardware token PIN, and division selector (Transnational Crime, Cyber Warfare, Anti-Money Laundering, INTERPOL).
- **Biometric Simulation**: Live hardware token validation sequence.
- **Evaluation Profiles**: One-click quick-login triggers for "Lead Investigator Sarah Vance" and "SIGINT Analyst".

### 2. Dashboard (`/`)
- **Command Center Telemetry**: Real-time status indicators with DEFCON-3 alert badge and sector telemetry.
- **Tactical KPI Metric Cards**:
  - *Active High-Value Targets* (42 HVTs with sparkline)
  - *Tracked Illicit Financial Flow* ($148.6M across 16 jurisdictions)
  - *Live Intercept Feeds* (189 active feeds)
  - *AI Anomaly Threat Index* (84.2 with neural recalculation)
- **Embedded Network Topology Radar**: Live interactive canvas showing the active criminal syndicate cluster for *Operation Phantom Web*.
- **Priority Intercept Stream**: Triage alert feed with AI confidence metrics, source identifiers (SIGINT, FINCEN, ANPR), and plot actions.
- **Active Operations Table**: Multi-jurisdictional case table with sorting, search, and status pills.

### 3. Cases & Warrants (`/cases`)
- **Case Management**: Filter by status (*Active Investigation*, *Interdiction Imminent*, *Surveillance Phase*, *Grand Jury*) and priority (*CRITICAL*, *HIGH*, *MEDIUM*).
- **Operational Metrics**: Aggregated warrants issued, seized asset values ($123.5M), and active target counts.
- **Case Dossier Inspection**: Detailed drawer showing case charters, lead agents, jurisdiction, and linked suspects.
- **Interactive Charter Issuance**: Modal to launch new operations with tactical codenames and AI auto-tagging.

### 4. Upload Evidence (`/upload`)
- **Ingestion Vault**: Multi-format support for Call Detail Records (CDR), SWIFT wire ledgers, VoLTE audio intercepts, ANPR video, and forensic disk images.
- **Automated SHA-256 Hashing**: Generates Title 18 compliant immutable checksums with instant clipboard copy.
- **Chain of Custody Protocol**: Custodial officer name, badge number, and GPS collection location.
- **4-Stage AI Pipeline Visualizer**:
  1. *SHA-256 Checksum Verification*
  2. *Named Entity Recognition (NER)*

  | 'shell_company' 
  | 'vehicle' 
  | 'burner_phone' 
  | 'bank_account' 
  | 'safehouse'

export type RiskLevel = 'CRITICAL' | 'HIGH' | 'ELEVATED' | 'LOW'

export interface Entity {
  id: string
  name: string
  type: EntityType
  riskScore: number // 0-100
  riskLevel: RiskLevel
  status: 'Active Warrant' | 'Under Surveillance' | 'Detained' | 'Fugitive' | 'Flagged Entity' | 'Monitored'
  aliases: string[]
  primaryAffiliation: string

  }

    dob?: string
    pob?: string

  }
}

  id: string

  category: 'Hawala Loop' | 'FASTag Transit' | 'SIM Call Burst'

  confidence: number

  | 'LAW ENFORCEMENT SENSITIVE'

  target: string

import React from 'react'
import { BrowserRouter, Routes, Route, Navigate } from 'react-router-dom'
import { ThemeProvider } from './context/ThemeContext'
import { AppLayout } from './components/layout/AppLayout'
import { LoginPage } from './pages/LoginPage'
import { DashboardPage } from './pages/DashboardPage'
import { UploadEvidencePage } from './pages/UploadEvidencePage'
import { NetworkAnalysisPage } from './pages/NetworkAnalysisPage'
import { EntityProfilePage } from './pages/EntityProfilePage'
import { EvidenceDetailsPage } from './pages/EvidenceDetailsPage'

export function App() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider>
      <BrowserRouter>
        <Routes>
          {/* Unauthenticated Login Portal */}
          <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />

          {/* Authenticated Dashboard Shell Layout */}
          <Route path="/" element={<AppLayout />}>
            {/* 5 Main Hackathon Screens */}
            <Route index element={<DashboardPage />} />
            <Route path="upload" element={<UploadEvidencePage />} />
            <Route path="network" element={<NetworkAnalysisPage />} />
            <Route path="person/:id" element={<EntityProfilePage />} />
            <Route path="person" element={<EntityProfilePage />} />
            <Route path="evidence/:id" element={<EvidenceDetailsPage />} />
            <Route path="evidence" element={<EvidenceDetailsPage />} />

            {/* Aliases for backwards compatibility */}
            <Route path="entity/:id" element={<EntityProfilePage />} />
            <Route path="entity" element={<EntityProfilePage />} />
          </Route>

          {/* Fallback */}
          <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
        </Routes>
      </BrowserRouter>
    </ThemeProvider>
  )
}

export default App

# NEXUS // AI-Powered Criminal Network Analysis Dashboard
### Smart India Hackathon (SIH 2026) Frontend Prototype

The NEXUS frontend has been streamlined and tailored for an **Indian law-enforcement context** (Special Cell Delhi Police & Uttar Pradesh Special Task Force - UP STF) for competition pitching and live judge demonstrations.

---

## 📍 Workspace & Server Access
- **Workspace Directory**: `C:\Users\Nityam Jaiswal\.gemini\antigravity\scratch\nexus`
- **Local URL**: [http://localhost:5173/](http://localhost:5173/)
- **Network / LAN URL**: `http://10.11.2.57:5173/`
- **Build Status**: Production build passed cleanly with 0 TypeScript errors (`tsc -b && vite build`).

---

## 🇮🇳 Indian Law-Enforcement Data Implemented

### 1. Sample Suspects & Persons (12 Total)
* **Core 5 Suspects**:
  1. **Rahul Verma** (Kingpin / Hawala Operator, Delhi Chandni Chowk, High Threat 94/100)
  2. **Amit Yadav** (Enforcer & Logistics, Ghaziabad Indirapuram, Threat 88/100)
  3. **Priya Singh** (Financial Mule / Shell Firms, Lucknow Hazratganj, Threat 79/100)
  4. **Suresh Sharma** (Weapons & Cross-Border Logistics, Mirzapur, Threat 85/100)
  5. **Neha Gupta** (Tech & VoIP Facilitator, Noida Sector 62, Threat 72/100)
* **Additional 7 Persons**:
  6. **Vikram Malhotra** (Noida Sector 18)
  7. **Deepak Rawat** (Meerut Cantt)
  8. **Sunita Devi** (Kanpur Nagar)
  9. **Manoj Tiwari** (Varanasi Cantt)
  10. **Anjali Kashyap** (Ghaziabad Raj Nagar)
  11. **Harish Chandra** (Delhi Rohini)
  12. **Pooja Saxena** (Lucknow Gomti Nagar)

### 2. Sample Locations (8 Core Monitored Corridors)
1. **Delhi** (Chandni Chowk / Connaught Place / Rohini)
2. **Ghaziabad** (Indirapuram / Raj Nagar)
3. **Lucknow** (Hazratganj / Gomti Nagar)
4. **Mirzapur** (Chunar / Rural Corridor)
5. **Noida** (Sector 62 / Sector 18)
6. **Meerut** (Cantt / Transport Nagar)
7. **Kanpur** (Civil Lines / Transport Hub)
8. **Varanasi** (Cantt Station Area)

### 3. Realistic Indian Identifiers & Evidence
- **Indian Vehicle Plates**: `UP14 AB 1234` (Mahindra Scorpio), `DL01 CA 9988` (Toyota Fortuner), `UP32 EK 4411`, `DL04 BK 5520`, etc.
- **Masked Phone Numbers**: `+91 98XXXXXX21`, `+91 97XXXXXX45`, `+91 99XXXXXX10`, `+91 98XXXXXX88`, `+91 96XXXXXX33`, etc.
- **Indian Rupee Figures**: `₹45,000`, `₹12,50,000`, `₹4,20,000`, `₹8,90,000`, `₹25,00,000`, etc.
- **Statutory Compliance**: Indian Evidence Act Section 65B electronic certificate compliance, SHA-256 integrity hashes, IPC/BNS charges (Section 120B, 420, 384, Arms Act 25, PMLA 3/4).

---

## 🎯 4 Core Dashboard KPI Metrics
1. **Tracked Persons**: **12 Persons** (5 High-Value Targets, 7 active associates)
2. **Monitored Locations**: **8 Locations** (NCR & UP Corridors: Delhi, Ghaziabad, Lucknow, Mirzapur, Noida, etc.)
3. **Identified Connections**: **15 Relationships** (Direct calls, Hawala wires, vehicle registrations)
4. **AI Detected Modus**: **3 Possible Patterns** (Hawala Loop, FASTag Transit, Call Burst)

---

## ⚡ 3 Detected Crime Patterns (Modus Operandi)
1. **Hawala Fund Layering Loop**: Circular transfer of ₹12,50,000 originating from a Chandni Chowk bullion trader, routed through Amit Yadav in Ghaziabad, and deposited into Priya Singh shell accounts in Lucknow within 4 hours.
2. **FASTag Toll Corridor Transit**: Mahindra Scorpio (`UP14 AB 1234`) clocked crossing Chhijarsi Toll Plaza (NH-9) at 02:14 AM and Jewar Toll Plaza at 03:22 AM, matching CDR cell-tower tower dump of Suresh Sharma.
3. **Burner SIM Call Burst (Pre-Crime)**: Coordinated burst of 38 short-duration VoLTE calls (<45s) across 3 masked burner SIMs (`98XXXXXX21` ➔ `97XXXXXX45`) immediately preceding cash transit.

---

## 🧭 Simplified 5 Main Screens

| Route | Page | Key Features for Hackathon Pitch |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `/` | **Dashboard** | 4 clean KPI cards, 3 AI Modus Operandi pattern cards, embedded network radar, recent Indian alerts feed, and 12 tracked suspects table. |
| `/upload` | **Upload Evidence** | CDR telecom dumps, FASTag ANPR toll camera logs, Canara Bank Hawala statements with Indian Section 65B certificate notes, SHA-256 hash generator, and 4-step AI pipeline visualizer. |
| `/network` | **Network Analysis** | Interactive SVG graph showing **5 to 8 connected core entities** by default with prominent readable labels, edge badges (e.g. ₹12.5L Hawala), 1-click shortest link tracer (Rahul Verma ➔ Amit Yadav ➔ Hawala Bank Acct), and toggle to expand to all 15 syndicate nodes. |
| `/person/:id` | **Person Details** | Detailed suspect dossier: photo, calculated threat score, alias, masked mobile, vehicle registration, Indian IPC/PMLA charges, bank footprint in ₹, and CDR call history. |
| `/evidence/:id` | **Evidence Details** | Single evidence inspector: Section 65B compliance verification, custodial officer (Sub-Insp R. K. Sharma), SHA-256 verification badge, linked suspects, and raw extracted payload. |

---

## 🕸️ High-Visibility Network Graph (5 to 8 Core Entities)
To prevent overwhelming hackathon judges:
- **Default Core Mode (7 prominent nodes)**:
  1. `Rahul Verma` (Suspect, Red Badge)
  2. `Amit Yadav` (Suspect, Red Badge)
  3. `Priya Singh` (Suspect, Red Badge)
  4. `Suresh Sharma` (Suspect, Red Badge)
  5. `Neha Gupta` (Suspect, Red Badge)
  6. `Scorpio [UP14 AB 1234]` (Vehicle, Cyan Badge)
  7. `Canara Bank [Hawala Acct]` (Financial, Emerald Badge)
- **Edge Badges**: Bold labels such as `₹12.5L Hawala`, `₹4.2L Layering`, `Vehicle Registered`, `38 Calls Burst`.
- **Expandable**: One-click *"Show All 15 Nodes"* toggle available during technical Q&A with judges.

---

## 🚀 Future Backend Architecture Readiness
The frontend remains strictly decoupled from backend services, making it prepared for future integration:
- All data models reside in clean TypeScript interfaces ([types/index.ts](file:///C:/Users/Nityam%20Jaiswal/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/nexus/src/types/index.ts)).
- Mock databases and relations are isolated in [mockData.ts](file:///C:/Users/Nityam%20Jaiswal/.gemini/antigravity/scratch/nexus/src/data/mockData.ts).
- Ready to be swapped with REST API or FastAPI / Django / Node.js backend endpoints without frontend refactoring.
